name: Turn off the advertising ID
description: Apps can no longer use your advertising ID for personalised ads.
mechanism: Sets Enabled=0 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo (Settings › Privacy & security › General).
benefit: Less cross-app ad tracking.
drawback: Ads in apps become less personalised.
evidence: Standard Settings privacy toggle.

name: Turn off tailored experiences
description: Microsoft won't use your diagnostic data to personalise tips, ads and recommendations.
mechanism: Sets TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled=0 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Privacy.
benefit: Fewer personalised tips and promotions.
drawback: None for functionality.
evidence: Standard Settings privacy toggle (Diagnostics & feedback).

name: Don't let websites access your language list
description: Websites receive less information about your installed languages.
mechanism: Sets HttpAcceptLanguageOptOut=1 under HKCU\Control Panel\International\User Profile.
benefit: Slightly reduces browser fingerprinting.
drawback: Some sites may not pick your preferred language automatically.
evidence: Standard Settings privacy toggle.

name: Feedback frequency: never ask
description: Windows stops showing feedback request pop-ups.
mechanism: Sets NumberOfSIUFInPeriod=0 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules (Settings › Diagnostics & feedback › Feedback frequency).
benefit: No feedback prompts appearing over games.
drawback: None.
evidence: Standard Settings value.

name: Policy: don't collect activity history
description: Windows stops recording and uploading activity history.
mechanism: Sets PublishUserActivities=0 and UploadUserActivities=0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System.
benefit: Less background logging and upload.
drawback: Activity-based features (e.g. resuming activities on other devices) are unavailable.
evidence: Documented Group Policies (OS Policies).

name: Policy: send only required diagnostic data
description: Limits Windows diagnostic data to the 'Required' level.
mechanism: Sets AllowTelemetry=1 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection. On Home and Pro, 1 (Required) is the lowest supported level; 0 is only honoured on Enterprise/Education.
benefit: Less optional diagnostic data collection and upload.
drawback: The 'Optional diagnostic data' option becomes managed by policy; some Insider/feedback features require optional data.
evidence: Microsoft 'Configure Windows diagnostic data in your organization'. Required diagnostic data is still sent — this does not disable diagnostics.

name: Policy: turn off Recall snapshots
description: Prevents Recall from saving screen snapshots (Copilot+ PCs).
mechanism: Sets DisableAIDataAnalysis=1 under HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI ('Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall').
benefit: No periodic screen capture/analysis, saving CPU/NPU, disk space and protecting privacy.
drawback: Recall cannot be used.
recommendedFor: Copilot+ PCs where Recall is not wanted. Harmless elsewhere.
evidence: Documented Windows AI policy (Windows 11 24H2).

name: Stop automatic installation of suggested apps
description: Windows stops silently downloading promoted apps and games.
mechanism: Sets SilentInstalledAppsEnabled=0 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager.
benefit: Prevents unexpected background downloads and new bloatware appearing in Start.
drawback: None.
evidence: Content Delivery Manager value written by Windows for consumer experience suggestions.

name: Don't show suggestions in Start
description: Removes app suggestions/promotions in the Start menu.
mechanism: Sets SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled=0 and SubscribedContent-338388Enabled=0 under HKCU\...\ContentDeliveryManager.
benefit: Fewer promotional tiles and ads.
drawback: None.
evidence: Content Delivery Manager values for 'Show suggestions occasionally in Start'.

name: Don't show tips and suggestions while using Windows
description: Stops 'Get tips and suggestions when using Windows' notifications.
mechanism: Sets SubscribedContent-338389Enabled=0 under HKCU\...\ContentDeliveryManager.
benefit: Fewer notifications that can pop up over full-screen games.
drawback: None.
evidence: Content Delivery Manager value for the Notifications tips toggle.

name: Don't show the Windows welcome experience after updates
description: Stops the full-screen 'What's new' page after feature updates.
mechanism: Sets SubscribedContent-310093Enabled=0 under HKCU\...\ContentDeliveryManager.
benefit: No unexpected full-screen pages after updates.
drawback: You won't see the feature tour.
evidence: Content Delivery Manager value for the Notifications welcome-experience toggle.

name: Don't show suggested content in Settings
description: Removes promotional suggestions inside the Settings app.
mechanism: Sets SubscribedContent-338393Enabled, -353694Enabled and -353696Enabled to 0 under HKCU\...\ContentDeliveryManager.
benefit: Cleaner Settings app without promotions.
drawback: None.
evidence: Content Delivery Manager values for 'Show me suggested content in the Settings app'.

name: Don't show fun facts and tips on the lock screen
description: Removes promotional text and tips from the lock screen.
mechanism: Sets RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled=0 and SubscribedContent-338387Enabled=0 under HKCU\...\ContentDeliveryManager.
benefit: Cleaner lock screen without promotions.
drawback: None.
evidence: Content Delivery Manager values for the lock-screen 'fun facts, tips, tricks' toggle.

name: Don't suggest ways to finish setting up the device
description: Stops the 'Let's finish setting up your device' full-screen nag.
mechanism: Sets ScoobeSystemSettingEnabled=0 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\UserProfileEngagement.
benefit: No full-screen prompts promoting Microsoft services.
drawback: None.
evidence: Standard Notifications setting value.

name: Policy: no web results in Windows Search
description: Start/taskbar search returns local results only.
mechanism: Sets the user policy DisableSearchBoxSuggestions=1 under HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer.
benefit: Faster, local-only search with no Bing queries sent while typing.
drawback: No web results in Start; recent search suggestions in Explorer's search box are also hidden.
recommendedFor: Users who search only local apps and files.
evidence: Documented Group Policy 'Turn off display of recent search entries in the File Explorer search box', which Windows Search also honours for web suggestions.

name: Turn off search highlights
description: Removes daily illustrations/trending content from the search box and panel.
mechanism: Sets IsDynamicSearchBoxEnabled=0 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\SearchSettings.
benefit: Less network-loaded content in the taskbar.
drawback: None.
evidence: Standard Settings value (Search permissions › Show search highlights).

name: Don't search cloud content (OneDrive/Outlook)
description: Windows Search stops including Microsoft account and work/school cloud content.
mechanism: Sets IsMSACloudSearchEnabled=0 and IsAADCloudSearchEnabled=0 under HKCU\...\SearchSettings.
benefit: Faster local search; fewer cloud queries.
drawback: OneDrive/Outlook/SharePoint content no longer appears in Windows Search.
recommendedFor: Users who don't search cloud files from Start.
evidence: Standard Settings values (Search permissions › Cloud content search).

name: Turn off inking & typing personalisation
description: Windows stops building a personal dictionary from your typing and handwriting.
mechanism: Sets RestrictImplicitInkCollection=1 and RestrictImplicitTextCollection=1 (HKCU\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization) and HarvestContacts=0 (…\TrainedDataStore).
benefit: Less local data collection.
drawback: Handwriting recognition and text suggestions are less personalised.
evidence: Values written by Settings › Privacy › Inking & typing personalization.

name: Start/Jump Lists: don't track recently opened files
description: Stops showing recently opened items in Start, Jump Lists and Explorer.
mechanism: Sets Start_TrackDocs=0 under HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced.
benefit: Privacy on shared or streamed screens.
drawback: Jump Lists no longer show recent files.
evidence: Standard Settings value (Start › Show recently opened items).

name: Start: don't track app launches
description: Windows stops tracking which apps you launch to build 'Most used'.
mechanism: Sets Start_TrackProgs=0 under HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced.
benefit: Privacy.
drawback: The 'Most used' list in Start disappears; search results are less personalised.
evidence: Standard Settings privacy value ('Let Windows improve Start and search results by tracking app launches').
